# expression text

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:expressionText`](gmeow-expressionText.md)

The expression source, verbatim, in the named language. Functional and mandatory (SHACL).

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:ConditionExpression`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionExpression.md) -> [`xsd:string`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string); functional

Use [`gmeow:expressionText`](gmeow-expressionText.md) from [`gmeow:ConditionExpression`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionExpression.md) to [`xsd:string`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to carry the verbatim source of a condition expression in its declared language.

### Avoid when

- Avoid omitting it or giving more than one (it is functional and mandatory by SHACL) and avoid mixing languages in one expression — declare the language with [`gmeow:expressionLanguage`](gmeow-expressionLanguage.md).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:expressionText`](gmeow-expressionText.md) once per [`gmeow:ConditionExpression`](../classes/gmeow-ConditionExpression.md) with the exact source, paired with [`gmeow:expressionLanguage`](gmeow-expressionLanguage.md).

### Examples

- ex:e1 [`gmeow:expressionText`](gmeow-expressionText.md) "ASK { ?s ex:requestedErasure true }".
